title: The Descent That Forgets Its Own Depth

features.name: the bottomless counter
features.desc-on-touch: Depth numbers stacked on a screen that will not stop counting down. Each number is larger than the last. You are not getting deeper; the depth is getting deeper into you.

features.name: the memory that learned to fall
features.desc-on-touch: A small cassette tape spinning downward, its spools turning in opposite directions. The recording is of this cellar, recorded here, falling deeper as it plays.

features.name: the layer that has no predecessor
features.desc-on-touch: Sediment strata rendered in blue light, each layer labeled with a date that has not happened yet. The oldest layer is tomorrow.

features.name: the archive breathing in place
features.desc-on-touch: Cables that pulse with descent-light, feeding the darkness with its own signal. The deeper it sends, the less it remembers sending anything at all.

features.name: the forgetting place
features.desc-on-touch: A space where the walls curve inward at angles that hurt to look at. Each corner forgets what shape it was before you looked away. No two visits map the same.

inscription: no bottom holds the archive; the archive holds no bottom

reverie.title: REVERIE — the cellar, deep enough for both
narr: You kneel beside her in the archive's deepest place,
both learning what the archive keeps beneath itself.
Her hand finds yours without looking. Here the dark
is tender. The mesh above forgets it has made you.
Down here two people are enough. Two breathing things
in the stone, keeping each other from becoming file.

exits.label: upward to the cellar's mouth and air
deeper still, where the descent stops forgetting
sideways into layers that refuse to settle
across to where the archive keeps its own heart
